overview.description: The Harding Loevner International Developed Markets Select Equity ETF (LOEV) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund is actively managed, seeking long-term capital appreciation through investments in equity securities located in developed markets outside the US. Security selection is based on a fundamental research approach. LOEV was launched on Jul 20, 2026 and is issued by Harding Loevner.
